motion.name: snappy-spring
motion.purpose: Settle card-content, task-progress, and editor color changes without overshoot.

breakpoints.name: compact-to-rail
breakpoints.purpose: Switch primary navigation from NavigationBar to NavigationRail.

narrative.overview: Material 3 Expressive provides the system for an adaptive, glanceable note canvas. Semantic color drives app chrome; note-specific colors distinguish user content. Deliberate shape contrast, adaptive card spans, and motion tied to task changes make the collection recognizable and actionable.

rules.name: The Semantic Chrome Rule
rules.body: App-level surfaces use Material color roles; user-selected note colors are reserved for note content and previews.

dos: Do adapt collection density and navigation to available window width.
Do respect system bars, cutouts, navigation gesture area, and IME.
donts: Don't use color alone to communicate selection or task completion.
Don't animate routine content without communicating a meaningful state change.
